services.desc: Join us for an exclusive cruising experience along the beautiful waterways of Michigan. Our cruises along the Detroit River, Lake St. Clair, and Lake Erie are more than just trips; they are an opportunity to immerse yourself in the splendid views and unique beauty of Michigan’s landscape. We’re passionate about showcasing the heart of Michigan’s natural and cultural landmarks in a way that’s both relaxing and breathtaking. On our cruises, you’ll have the chance to appreciate Michigan’s waterfronts from a unique vantage point - the comfort of our boat.
